name: book-to-wiki-graph
description: Convert books into TOC-centered Wiki graphs with reviewed atoms, three-pass dual-layer concept relations, and two-level Obsidian knowledge constellations.

interface.shortDescription: Turn books into atomic Wiki graphs.
interface.longDescription: Convert a book PDF to Markdown, derive an open-depth organizer hierarchy, review source-complete atoms, map canonical concepts and teaching relations in three evidence-bound passes, validate the corpus, and generate a chapter atlas plus dual-layer knowledge constellations with curated method examples and exercise-organizer clusters.
defaultPrompt: Convert this PDF into a TOC-centered Wiki graph.
Audit and repair this book graph with two-pass semantic atomization.
Use the knowledge-relation mapper to build a three-pass atom-concept teaching graph.
Build two-level learning-path knowledge constellations with selective concept hubs, exercise clusters, and reviewed major-method examples.
